text.EN: It's down. I need a weapon.
text.TL: Bagsak na. Kailangan ko ng sandata.

text.EN: Managed that barehanded, but find me something to swing.
text.TL: Nakaraos nang walang gamit, pero hanapan mo ako ng mahahawakan.

text.EN: Too close for comfort. We need gear.
text.TL: Masyadong delikado. Kailangan natin ng gamit.

text.EN: Took it down, but I can't keep doing that.
text.TL: Naibagsak ko, pero hindi ko kayang ulit-ulitin 'yon.

text.EN: It's dead. Look around for any weapon.
text.TL: Patay na. Maghanap ka ng anumang pamalo sa paligid.

text.EN: Shoved and stomped. Get me something sharp.
text.TL: Tinulak at tinapakan. Bigyan mo ako ng kahit matalim.
Masyadong delikado. Kailangan ng maayos na gamit.

text.EN: Downed it without gear. Won't get lucky twice.
text.TL: Naitumba nang walang armas. Huwag umasang mauulit ang swerte.

text.EN: Bare hands worked once. Find weapons now.
text.TL: Gumabana ang mga kamay nang minsan. Maghanap ng sandata ngayon.

text.EN: Bruised knuckles, but it's dead. Gear up.
text.TL: Pasa ang kamao ko, pero patay na. Mag-armas tayo.
